motivation: CSSC statistical review requested month-level cross-validation for primary TAIL threshold selection and removal of the uncalibrated same-sample KS gate.
fold_design: Four disjoint chronological month folds, six held-out months per fold; fit on the other 18 months.
selection_score: Mean deterministic CRPS over 24 held-out monthly maxima, averaged across the four folds.
gpd_fit: Maximum likelihood with location fixed at zero.
count_model: Select Poisson versus negative binomial by the registered variance-to-mean rule, independently within each fitting fold and again on the complete history.
subthreshold_component: Empirical monthly maxima of declustered cluster peaks not exceeding the candidate threshold.
fit_diagnostic: Shape-parameter percentile-bootstrap interval width evaluated on the selected full-history fit with 500 resamples; negative endpoint must cover the observed cluster peaks.
nominal_same_sample_ks_gate: Removed; retained only as an uncalibrated descriptive diagnostic in archived source outputs.
randomness: Threshold-selection CRPS is deterministic conditional on each fold fit. The 500-resample full-fit shape interval uses the replication-indexed registered RNG stream.
outputs: all candidate-by-fold CRPS and fit diagnostics
